storeInfo.name: Lilac House
storeInfo.tagline: Exquisite Asian Specialties & Fine Dining in Fairfield, CT

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Delicados dumplings caseros rellenos de carne de cerdo jugosa y jengibre fresco, servidos con salsa de soja picante.
products.descriptionEn: Delicate house-made dumplings filled with savory pork and fresh ginger, served with a zesty soy dipping sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Rollitos fritos dorados rellenos de verduras mixtas frescas y vidrio de arroz, acompañados de salsa agridulce.
products.descriptionEn: Golden fried spring rolls stuffed with fresh mixed vegetables and glass noodles, served with sweet and sour sauce.
Steamed young soybean pods tossed with flaky coarse sea salt.

products.nameEs: Calamares Saltados con Pimienta y Sal
products.descriptionEn: Lightly battered and crispy fried tender calamari tossed with jalapeños, scallions, and Sichuan pepper.
Crispy dark-meat chicken chunks tossed in a sweet, spicy, and tangy glaze served alongside steamed broccoli.
Crispy shredded beef glazed with pure honey and toasted sesame seeds served over fresh crisp lettuce.
Wok-tossed rice noodles with succulent shrimp, eggs, bean sprouts, crushed peanuts, and fresh lime.

products.nameEs: Verduras de la Huerta al Wok con Tofu
products.descriptionEn: Crispy organic tofu sautéed with bok choy, shiitake mushrooms, carrots, and snow peas in a light garlic sauce.
Roasted duck with ultra-crisp skin and tender meat, served with warm pancakes, scallions, and rich hoisin sauce.

products.nameEs: Pescado Entero al Vapor con Jengibre y Cebollino
products.nameEn: Steamed Whole Fish with Ginger & Scallions
products.descriptionEn: Fresh catch of the day steamed and bathed in aromatic sweet soy, topped with julienned ginger and sizzling oil.
Wok-tossed jasmine rice with chicken, beef, shrimp, cashews, pineapple, and a subtle touch of yellow curry.

products.nameEs: Té Helado de Jazmín y Limón
products.descriptionEn: Refreshing jasmine green tea infused with fresh Amalfi lemons and a touch of wild wildflower honey.
Crisp, clean, and refreshing Japanese rice lager with a dry, clean finish.
Elegant wine featuring notes of ripe cherry, raspberry, and a subtle hint of spiced oak.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con una amplia variedad de platos vegetarianos, veganos y adaptables sin gluten. Por favor informe a su mesero sobre cualquier alergia.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer a wide variety of vegetarian, vegan, and adaptable gluten-free dishes. Please inform your server of any food allergies.

faqs.qEs: ¿Aceptan reservaciones o ofrecen servicio para llevar?
faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations or offer takeout?
faqs.aEs: ¡Sí! Aceptamos tanto clientes sin reservación como reservaciones por teléfono. También ofrecemos servicio completo para llevar.
faqs.aEn: Yes! We welcome both walk-ins and phone reservations. We also offer full takeout service for pickup.
